classification.difficultyReason: Scaffolded: part a is a single tan calculation, part b adds the given eye height. The diagram marks every quantity.

content.prompt: From a point $30\text{ m}$ from the base of a flagpole, Mia measures the angle of elevation of the top of the flagpole to be $24^\circ$. Her eye level is $1.5\text{ m}$ above the ground.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the height, $d$, of the top of the flagpole above her eye level, to 1 decimal place.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the height of the flagpole, to 1 decimal place.
